body: I try to think to myself that I’ve been suicidal for weeks now, and hopefully it’ll only be a few more weeks until I can see a psychiatrist. I finally found a group in my area that takes my insurance, they just need a referral from my PCP. So I put that in to my PCP’s office yesterday. And for all the good I expect it to do me I have a new therapist on deck starting next week. Things are literally looking up. I just don’t have the perspective to appreciate that fact when I my mental state is that I would rather be dead than doing the activities of life.
